good_thing: (Big Sur, California): A California State Parks ranger found a juvenile turkey vulture near Julia Pfeiffer Burns State Park after it appears to have fled the Timber Fire prematurely. The 40-to-50-day-old bird is receiving warmth, nutrition, and supportive care at SPCA Monterey County’s Wildlife Rescue and Rehabilitation Center, where staff expect a full recovery.
current_or_history: On September 4, 1781, 44 settlers, including 11 men, 11 women, and 22 children, set out from Mission San Gabriel to found El Pueblo de la Reyna de Los Angeles. The group included people of African, Indigenous, and European heritage, and its nine-mile walk ended at the site of the Gabrieleno village of Yangna.
tiny_fact: Wombats are the only known animals to excrete cubic feces. Researchers found that the corners form in the distal colon, where changing stiffness in intestinal tissue helps mold the cubes.
thought: A small bit of care can be enough to help something find its way back.
